text:
maya: quick post-launch check — we pushed the new landing for the webinar but noticed the signup funnel is getting UTM noise. need a short tech-SEO sweep (redirects, canonical, schema) before the paid push tomorrow. who can own?
rob: I can run the redirect list and canonical checks. sending a diff in a sec. :white_check_mark:
sasha: I’ll validate the webinar schema and structured data for the registration block. last time rich results flaked.
elliot: can someone confirm the priority keyword set we surface in H1/H2? marketing changed copy overnight. want to avoid losing our benchmark narrative anchors.
maya: @elliot the baseline KW we committed to: "llm inference platform", "low-latency inference", "dedicated inference" — keep those in headings and meta if possible.
priya: adding a quick checklist: 1) canonical header present 2) 301 redirect map validated 3) webinar schema (Event) + FAQ markup 4) noindex on staging URLs 5) internal links to docs/benchmarks page 6) GTM UTM normalization.
rob: draft redirect map (small sample) — please review:
```
# redirect-map.csv
/old-webinar-signup -> /webinar/2026-03-inference-launch 301
/landing-v2 -> /webinar/2026-03-inference-launch 301
/register?ref=fb_ad -> /webinar/2026-03-inference-launch?utm_source=facebook 301
```
rob: question — do we canonicalize all variations to /webinar/2026-03-inference-launch or keep query-preserving?
sasha: canonical should point to the clean path without query. use rel=canonical to /webinar/2026-03-inference-launch. for analytics, add canonical + UTM in redirect target so GA receives consistent landing.
elliot: small nit: H1 now "Redwood Inference: Fast, Reliable LLM Serving" — suggest H2 include exact phrase "low-latency inference" to match KW intent.
priya: schema snippets I want in the page: Event (startDate/endDate), offers (free), organizer (Redwood Inference), and FAQ schema for common blockers. sasha can drop the exact JSON-LD.
sasha: JSON-LD draft (paste into page head):
```
<script type=\"application/ld+json\">{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference Launch Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-02T16:00:00Z",
  "endDate": "2026-04-02T17:00:00Z",
  "eventStatus": "https://schema.org/EventScheduled",
  "organizer": {"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference","url":"https://redwood.inference"}
}
</script>
```
sasha: also add FAQPage snippet below hero. I’ll push a PR.
rob: I ran the 301s through a quick curl script — 2 minor loops found, fixed them in the draft. pushing to /ops-redirects for review.
maya: @seo-bot can you run a quick preflight? want errors flagged in thread.
seo-bot: preflight complete. issues found: ["missing canonical on /landing-v2", "multiple 302s detected on /old-webinar-signup -> temp proxy", "missing Event startDate timezone"]
priya: I’ll handle the canonical injection and timezone normalization.
elliot: final copy ask: ensure meta description retains keyword "inference economics" and includes webinar CTA. analytics wants consistent description for the benchmark narrative.
rob: cc @eng-frontend — will need small header change and a 301 deploy window (15m).
priya: timeline: I can patch canonical + schema in next 30m, rob will deploy redirect fixes in 45m, sasha will open PR for JSON-LD and FAQ. then we re-run preflight.
maya: perfect. once all green we flip tracking for paid push. thanks team! :rocket:
rob: uploaded redirect diff: https://git.internal/redwood/redirects/commit/fe12ab
sasha: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/web/PR/482 — adds JSON-LD + FAQ markup
seo-bot: follow-up preflight scheduled in 40m. noindex staging verified.
priya: I'll also add an internal link from /docs/benchmarks -> webinar landing for stronger internal anchor flow.
elliot: will update H2 and meta then sign off.
maya: thread closed after deploy — ping if anything blocks.
